Horse Side Vet Guide™ 
- A Mobile Application for Horse Owners & Equine Professionals -  
AVAILABLE on iTunes & Google Play 

Created by an expert in equine veterinary medicine with over 20 years of experience, Horse Side Vet Guide™ helps you determine how to best resolve an equine healthcare problem. Far more than a mobile first-aid app, HSVG contains an extensive list of observations, skills, how-to videos, veterinary diagnostics, diagnoses, treatments, and so much more.  

Want to know more?  Visit www.horsesidevetguide.com and join our email list!
